Players Committee card image of [[Elis In Hinthra]] (original printing), game text: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Elis, who provides ability of 2. Once per game, may deploy a smuggler aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While at opponent's system, adds one [Light Side]. Immune to attrition <5.”
